```artifact
Feature: System Usability and Documentation

  Scenario: Non-technical users can complete a Consultation Request within 5 minutes
    Given a user with no computer background
    When the user initiates a Consultation Request
    Then the user should be able to complete the request in less than 5 minutes
    And only minimal and relevant questions are presented

  Scenario: System navigation is simple and intuitive
    Given a user navigating the system
    When the user attempts to perform a task
    Then the user should reach the task completion point in no more than three clicks

  Scenario: Installation Guide is prepared
    Given the system is to be installed
    When the installation guide is accessed
    Then the guide should contain step-by-step instructions for downloading, extracting, and running the installation script

  Scenario: User Manual for end users is prepared
    Given an end user accessing the system
    When the user manual is consulted
    Then the manual should provide clear instructions for using the system

  Scenario Outline: Verify installation steps
    Given the system package is downloaded
    When the package is extracted to the designated directory
    And the installation script is run
    Then the installation should complete successfully
    Examples:
      | step                     | expected_result |
      | Download the latest system package | Package is downloaded successfully |
      | Extract the package to the designated directory | Package is extracted without errors |
      | Run the installation script | Installation completes without errors |

  Scenario Outline: Verify user manual content
    Given an end user consulting the user manual
    When the user manual content is reviewed
    Then the manual should provide clear instructions for each system feature
    Examples:
      | feature                     | expected_instruction |
      | Consultation Request        | Clear step-by-step instructions |
      | System Navigation          | Intuitive navigation guidance |
      | Installation Process       | Detailed installation steps |
```
